name: 01020 · Chicopee, MA
findings: ZIP 01020 (Chicopee) has 55 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01020 (Chicopee) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 01020 (Chicopee) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 46% of the typical level).
